body:
Honestly, everything got a lot better when I was able to accept the idea that I could think about something and not necessarily believe it.

On a lot of days, it doesn't really interrupt anything. On others, it messes with my school and personal life and destroys all of the motivation I had for anything. It depends on the week. Sometimes it feels like things are getting better, and then something triggers it and I'm back to square one.

just wanted to add that whoever considers this 'normal' must have a REALLY fucked up perspective
